description: What size ceiling fan you need for a room: the suggested blade span from the room's square footage, the largest fan that keeps 18 in from the walls, and the mount type for your ceiling height. Formula: Area = length × width. Blade span: up to 75 sq ft 29–36 in; 76–144 sq ft 36–42 in; 144–225 sq ft 44 in; 225–400 sq ft 50–54 in; over 400 sq ft 54–72 in or several fans. Largest span with 18 in wall clearance = shorter side (in) − 36 in. Mount: 8 ft or lower → hugger; 8–9 ft → standard downrod; higher → extended downrod.
name: calc_ceiling_fan_size
title: Ceiling Fan Size Calculator (Blade Span by Room Size)
